newsitem.title: INDIA: India say Bhutto government ousting internal issue.
newsitem.headline: India say Bhutto government ousting internal issue.

text.p: Senior members of an Indian delegation in Zimbabwe with Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda told an Indian news agency on Tuesday the sacking of Pakistani Prime Minister Benazir Bhutto's government was an internal affair.

But one official source in the delegation told India's Asian News International (ANI) agency in Harare the democratic process in Pakistan had been "clearly thwarted" with the dismissal of Bhutto's government.
Deve Gowda and his delegation, including Foreign Minister Inder Gujral, are in Zimbabwe for a G-15 economic conference of developing countries.
Senior delegation members, who asked not to be named, said the dismissal of Bhutto's government was an internal affair of Pakistan and, as such, India had no comment, ANI reported.
ANI said the G-15 meeting appeared to have been overtaken by events in Pakistan, with most delegations awaiting further news.
It said Deve Gowda planned to return to Harare from Victoria Falls and would hold a news conference after arriving in the Zimbabwean capital later on Tuesday.
